candidates.title: Pet Voice & Personality Tuning Stage
candidates.change: Adds an interactive voice and behavior tuning screen before photo uploads where users select pitch, audio responses, and personality style.
candidates.why: The adoption step has 72.3% conversion and 1017s mean duration; giving users early voice and trait preview reduces customization friction.

new_voice_personality_stage.headline: Tune Your Desktop Pet Voice & Traits
new_voice_personality_stage.body: Select sound effects, voice pitch, and greeting behavior.

guard.reason: Adding a new tuning stage within onboarding is allowed and preserves all existing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (adoption), but adding a complex screen to an already long step might increase duration.

candidates.title: Multi-Asset Desktop Live Render Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split rendering stage displaying pet asset build stages and live system tray integration status.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pets not opening or failing to display on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Preparing animations, desktop tray integration, and screen interactions.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen while preserving its core job of showing the pet being made.

candidates.score_note: Directly backed by 2336s wait time and 3 support emails, but requires extensive UI redesign.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Tray & Pet Control Sandbox Flow
candidates.change: Adds a hands-on control testing flow on the final screen where users practice summoning, dragging, and hiding the pet before ending onboarding.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails on pet controls/hiding and 4 emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior after setup.

home_intro.headline: Try Your Desktop Controls Now
home_intro.body: Practice essential tray actions and screen hotkeys before entering your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interactive onboarding sandbox within the home intro step.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (7 emails total) for finish step issues, though building a sandbox flow has high effort.

candidates.title: Post-Certificate Cloud Safeguard Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step immediately after adoption certificate completion so users secure their newly named pet to a cloud account before asset rendering.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets upon signing in again later.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 and retains all steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 8 support tickets about lost pets, but sign_in conversion is already high (94.6%).

candidates.title: Quick Companion Onboarding Speed Hint
candidates.change: Displays an onboarding duration hint and instant pet availability callout on the choose path screen.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s compared to 8s median, showing long tail confusion or hesitation.

candidates.title: Real-Time Desktop Render Activity Feed
candidates.change: Enables progress tracking and readiness notifications on the waiting screen while background assets render.
candidates.why: Users face long background wait times (mean 2336s) and uncertainty about when the desktop pet is ready to spawn.

waiting.hint: Your pet is initializing graphics shaders and tray controls.

guard.reason: Adding activity feed and real wait time estimates to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Wait-state status feeds reliably reduce drop-off during extreme wait times (2336s mean).

candidates.title: Account Sync Risk Warning Banner
candidates.change: Adds an account persistence security warning banner to the sign-in screen informing users about guest data reset risks.
candidates.why: 8 users reported lost pets after re-authenticating, making account persistence risks critical to state upfront.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Lives in the System Tray
home_intro.body: Click the tray icon anytime to open controls, switch pets, or manage settings.

guard.reason: Spotlight layout redesign for the home intro overlay is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweak addressing frequent post-onboarding support issues at moderate drop-off step (15.9% loss).

candidates.change: Redesigns the intro story screen into a split layout showcasing instant preset vs custom companion creation options.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 13.4% of users and suffers from a high mean completion time of 514s.

candidates.change: Updates photo upload screen text with clear lighting and pose guidelines to prevent photo conversion errors.
